items.heading: Polymer Science Is Not
items.text: Polymer science is not a small, niche academic subject with only research jobs at the end of it. It is a real, industrially embedded field with five distinct career tracks, most of which hire steadily at the bachelor's and diploma level in manufacturing and testing roles, with a smaller, higher-paying research layer on top for those who go on to an M.Tech or PhD.
